extensionDescription.message: Save the current webpage, selected content, or a right-clicked image to your self-hosted EdgeEver instance.

optionsSubtitle.message: Configure your self-hosted EdgeEver instance connection and default notebook.

diagnosticsDescription.message: View basic extension, browser, system, and connection information. API tokens are never included.

diagnosticsCopyFailed.message: Copy failed. Check the browser clipboard permission.

autoFirstNotebook.message: Use the first notebook automatically after connecting

missingSettingsDetails.message: Enter the EdgeEver instance URL and API token in the extension settings first.

instancePermissionRequired.message: Allow the extension to access your EdgeEver instance.

noAvailableNotebooks.message: No notebooks are available in EdgeEver.

currentPageNotFound.message: Could not find the current page.

captureTimeout.message: Page extraction did not finish within 15 seconds. The page may be large or still loading; refresh it and try again.

pageAccessDenied.message: The extension cannot read this page. Browser internal pages, extension stores, and restricted pages cannot be captured.

instanceNetworkFailed.message: Could not connect to the EdgeEver instance. Check the instance URL, network connection, and CORS settings.

emptyPageContent.message: (No readable content was found on this page)

selectionSaveHint.message: Select text on a page, right-click, and choose “Save selection to EdgeEver”. It is saved as a new note in the default notebook selected below.

selectionSaved.message: Saved the selection as a note.

selectionEmpty.message: No text was selected, so nothing was saved.

imageSaveHint.message: Right-click an image on a webpage and choose “Save image to EdgeEver”. It is saved as a new note in the default notebook selected below.

imageUnreadable.message: The image file could not be read, so nothing was saved. It may be drawn by the page, or it may require a signed-in download.

imageTooLarge.message: This image is larger than 20 MB, so it was not saved.

imageUnsupportedType.message: This image format cannot be saved into a note yet. PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, and AVIF are supported.

imagePermissionIntro.message: This page cannot read the image file. After you allow the site that hosts it, EdgeEver saves it as a new note in the clipper's default notebook. Only the image you chose is read.

imagePermissionToast.message: Allow access to this image's site to save it.

allowAllSitesAndSave.message: Allow all sites, then save future images directly

imagePermissionDenied.message: Site access was not allowed, so the image was not saved.

imageResourceScopeRequired.message: This API token cannot write attachments. Create a full-access token in EdgeEver settings.

imageSaveExpired.message: This save has expired. Right-click the image and try again.

tweetSaveHint.message: On X, right-click a post and choose “Save post to EdgeEver”. The post text, including text behind Show more, and the photos go into one new note in the same default notebook.

tweetSaved.message: Saved this post as a note.

tweetNotFound.message: Could not find that post. Right-click directly on the post.

tweetPermissionIntro.message: A timeline has many posts. Allow access to X so the clipper can remember the post under the pointer. After that, right-click the same post once more. Only the post you choose is saved to the clipper's default notebook.

tweetPermissionToast.message: Allow access to X to choose a post on the timeline. Then right-click that post again.

tweetRightClickAgain.message: Posts on the timeline can be recognized now. Right-click that post again.

tweetPermissionDenied.message: Access was not allowed. Right-click the post again to retry.

tweetPermissionReady.message: Access allowed. Go back and right-click that post again.

githubRepoSaveHint.message: On a GitHub repository page or code tree, right-click the page background, the description, or the README text and choose “Save repository info to EdgeEver”. The address and description are saved as a new note in the default notebook selected above. Issue, discussion, and single-file pages are left unsaved.

githubRepoSaved.message: Saved this repository as a note.

githubRepoNotPage.message: This is not a GitHub repository page or code tree, so nothing was saved.

githubRepoUnreadable.message: The repository details could not be read, so nothing was saved.

xhsSaveHint.message: On Xiaohongshu, right-click the note text and choose “Save note to EdgeEver”. The title, text, and photos go into one new note. Comments are left out. Right-clicking a photo still saves that image only.

xhsNotFound.message: Could not find that note. Open it, then right-click the text.

xhsNeedsOpen.message: Open the note, then right-click its text.

xhsPermissionIntro.message: The feed has many notes. Allow access to Xiaohongshu so the clipper can remember the note under the pointer. After that, right-click the same note once more. Only the note you choose is saved to the clipper's default notebook.

xhsPermissionToast.message: Allow access to Xiaohongshu to choose a note on the feed. Then right-click that note again.

xhsRightClickAgain.message: Notes on the feed can be recognized now. Right-click that note again.

xhsPermissionDenied.message: Access was not allowed. Right-click the note again to retry.

xhsPermissionReady.message: Access allowed. Go back and right-click that note again.

saveZhihuToEdgeEver.message: Save answer or article to EdgeEver

zhihuSaveHint.message: On Zhihu, right-click the answer or article text and choose “Save answer or article to EdgeEver”. The title, author, text, and photos go into one new note. Comments are left out. Right-clicking a photo still saves that image only.

savingZhihu.message: Saving this Zhihu answer or article…

zhihuSaved.message: Saved this Zhihu answer or article.

zhihuNotFound.message: Could not find that answer or article. Right-click its text.

zhihuUnreadable.message: Could not read that answer or article, so nothing was saved.

zhihuPermissionIntro.message: This page lists more than one answer or article. Allow access to Zhihu so the clipper can remember the one under the pointer. After that, right-click the same text once more. Only the item you choose is saved to the clipper's default notebook.

zhihuPermissionToast.message: Allow access to Zhihu to choose an answer or article in the list. Then right-click that text again.

zhihuRightClickAgain.message: Answers and articles on this page can be recognized now. Right-click that text again.

zhihuPermissionDenied.message: Access was not allowed. Right-click the text again to retry.

zhihuPermissionReady.message: Access allowed. Go back and right-click that text again.

zhihuSaveWindowTitle.message: Save answer or article to EdgeEver

redditSaved.message: Saved this Reddit post as a note.

redditNotFound.message: Could not find that Reddit post. Right-click directly on a post.

redditRightClickAgain.message: Reddit posts can be recognized now. Right-click that post again.

videoTranscriptSaved.message: Saved the captions. No summary was generated.

videoTranscriptNeedScope.message: Saved the captions. No summary was generated. Add the ai:generate scope to the token in settings, and choose a default model.

videoTranscriptNeedModel.message: Saved the captions. No summary was generated. Choose a default model first.

videoTranscriptTooLong.message: Saved the captions. This video is too long to summarize.

videoPageUnsupported.message: This page is not supported yet.
